Name: CACL_CORRECT_GRAPH_ST
Description: Handles value curve functions for various mechanics.

Fields.Name: Threshold Point [0]
Fields.Description: Stat value where this stage of the curve starts. For weapons this is a stat point such as 40 Strength. List the five stages from low to high.

Fields.Name: Threshold Coefficient [0] (%)
Fields.Description: Share of total scaling reached at this growth stage. 100 completes the curve here, but values can exceed 100. The matching Threshold Point sets the stage's stat value.

Fields.Name: Adjustment Factor [0]
Fields.Description: Curve shape between this stage's bounds. 1 draws a straight line. Higher values start flat and steepen, lower values start steep, and negative values mirror the curve.

Fields.Name: Leveling Cost - Initial Cost
Fields.Description: Initial slope of the level-up cost curve. Only the level-up cost row uses it. The exact formula is not established.

Fields.Name: Leveling Cost - Initial Offset
Fields.Description: Flat adjustment to early level-up costs. Only the level-up cost row uses it. The exact formula is not established.

Fields.Name: Leveling Cost - Cost Increase
Fields.Description: Extra slope added to level-up costs past the threshold. Only the level-up cost row uses it. The exact formula is not established.

Fields.Name: Leveling Cost - Increase Interval
Fields.Description: Level where the cost curve switches to its steeper shape. Only the level-up cost row uses it. The exact formula is not established.
